# planner API

Mowing patterns, spot paths and plans.

Base path `/api/v1/planner` behind the gateway. Authentication, rate limits and the error format are the same for every service: see [Scripting MowDeck](../../guides/scripting.md). Rendered from [`apps/web/openapi/planner.json`](https://github.com/lukislp/mowdeck/blob/main/apps/web/openapi/planner.json) (OpenAPI 3.1), which you can also load into any OpenAPI tool.

## Operations

### planner

#### POST /api/v1/planner/coverage/gaps

**Coverage Gaps**

Covered ground and the gaps of an area from the mower's position track (Telemetry) between `start` and `end`, with a `remow` step for them.

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [GapsRequestIn](#gapsrequestin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [GapsOut](#gapsout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### GET /api/v1/planner/patterns

**List Patterns**

Every registered pattern with its settings schema (plug-ins included).

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [PatternList](#patternlist) |

#### POST /api/v1/planner/plans

**Create Plan**

The plan ready to start: the `SpotMowPlan` with its hash and the `start_mow` command for Fleet. Nothing is stored; the same request gives the same hash. Needs `can_control` on the mower (Fleet checks it again when the command arrives).

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [PlanRequestIn](#planrequestin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [PlanOut](#planout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### POST /api/v1/planner/plans/preview

**Preview Plan**

Compute and validate a plan and show it: segments, duration, area, warnings, and how the mower can run it. Needs `can_view` on the mower (404 when invisible).

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [PlanRequestIn](#planrequestin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [PreviewOut](#previewout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

## Schemas

### AreaIn

Where to mow. `area_id` alone is a whole map area; a polygon (local metres or WGS84 `[lat, lon]`) is a spot, inside `area_id` when given, else inside the mapped areas.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `area_id` | string or null | no |  |
| `holes` | array of array of array of any | no | max items 50 |
| `polygon` | array of array of any or null | no |  |
| `polygon_wgs84` | array of array of any or null | no | `[lat, lon]` pairs. |

### ChainStepIn

One pattern of a chain with its settings (validated by the pattern's schema).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pattern` | string | yes | max length 64; pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$` |
| `settings` | object | no |  |

### DockPose

Position and orientation of the charging station in the local frame.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `heading_deg` | number | no | Local frame, counter-clockwise from +x.; min 0.0; less than 360.0; default `0.0` |
| `x` | number | yes |  |
| `y` | number | yes |  |

### ExecutionOut

How the mower can run the plan.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `"custom_paths"` \| `"native"` \| `"unsupported"` \| `"unknown"` | yes | `custom_paths`: the mower follows the route; `native`: it runs `native_job` on the map area; `unsupported`: it cannot run this plan; `unknown`: no capabilities (a raw map). |
| `native_job` | object or null | no | `StartMow.pattern` settings of the native form, if any. |
| `reason` | string | yes |  |

Covered ground and gaps; `remow` is a ready chain step for the gaps.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |

| `gap_area_m2` | number | yes |  |

Which parts of an area did the mower miss between `start` and `end`?

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `area` | [AreaIn](#areain) or null | no | Default: the map area with the most track points. |

| `min_gap_m2` | number | no | min 0.0; max 100.0; default `0.05` |
| `mower_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `start` | string (date-time) | yes |  |

### GeoReference

Anchors the local frame on the earth.

The local point `(0, 0)` is at `(origin_lat, origin_lon)`. The local axes are the east and north axes rotated counter-clockwise by `rotation_deg`: a local point `(x, y)` lies `east = x cos(r) - y sin(r)` and `north = x sin(r) + y cos(r)` metres from the origin.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `origin_lat` | number | yes | min -90.0; max 90.0 |
| `origin_lon` | number | yes | min -180.0; max 180.0 |
| `rotation_deg` | number | no | min -360.0; max 360.0; default `0.0` |

A plan for a mower (`mower_id`: its map and capabilities) or for a raw `map`.

| `area` | [AreaIn](#areain) | yes |  |

| `template` | string or null | no | Use the chain of a saved template instead of `chain`. |

| `turn_style` | [TurnStyle](#turnstyle) or null | no | Shape the lane ends for a spot run that turns this way (ADR 0043): `arc` (U-turn or bulb turn), `multi_point` (three-point turn; `arc` when the mower's drive link cannot reverse) or `in_place`; null keeps the straight connections. |
| `wgs84` | boolean | no | Preview coordinates as `[lon, lat]`.; default `false` |

### SpotMowPlan

A computed mowing route for `StartMow.spot_plan`.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `covered_area_m2` | number | no | min 0.0; default `0.0` |
| `estimated_duration_s` | number | no | min 0.0; default `0.0` |
| `native` | [SpotNativeJob](#spotnativejob) or null | no |  |
| `pattern_chain` | array of string | yes | min items 1; max items 16 |
| `plan_hash` | string | yes | SHA-256 of the chain and the segments (`spot_plan_hash`); must match.; pattern `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` |
| `segments` | array of [SpotSegment](#spotsegment) | yes | min items 1; max items 10000 |

### SpotNativeJob

The plan expressed as a native job of the mower: whole map areas and one pattern.

Present only when the chain is exactly one pattern the mower may run by itself (`stripes`, `diagonal`, `checkerboard`, `edge_only`, or `border_fill` with one of them) on map areas, so a mower without `custom_paths` can still execute it as an ordinary `StartMow(area_ids, pattern)`.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `area_ids` | array of string | yes | min items 1 |
| `pattern` | object | yes | Settings in the form of `StartMow.pattern` (`name`, `angle_deg`, `spacing_m`, `border_laps`, `order`). |

### SpotSegment

One part of a spot plan: drive along `path` with the blades on or off (backwards with `reverse`: the mower faces against the direction of travel, part of a three-point turn).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `blades_on` | boolean | yes |  |
| `kind` | `"mow"` \| `"turn"` \| `"transfer"` | no | default `"mow"` |
| `path` | string | yes | Encoded polyline of local metres (x, y), centimetre precision (`encode_polyline`), at least two points.; min length 4; max length 200000 |
| `reverse` | boolean | no | Drive the polyline backwards (negative linear speed, the mower faces against the direction of travel); always with the blades off (ADR 0043).; default `false` |
| `speed_mps` | number | yes | max 2.0; greater than 0.0 |

### StartMow

Start mowing the given areas, a stored plan or an inline spot plan (exactly one).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `area_ids` | array of string | no | Map area ids to mow, in order. |
| `kind` | `"start_mow"` | no | default `"start_mow"` |
| `pattern` | object or null | no | Pattern settings (validated by the pattern's own JSON Schema). |
| `plan_ref` | string or null | no | Reference to a stored mowing plan. |
| `spot_plan` | [SpotMowPlan](#spotmowplan) or null | no | A route computed by the Planner (spot mowing). Runs only on mowers with `custom_paths`, or natively when the plan carries a `native` job. |

### TransitIn

Where a spot run's transit would start (ADR 0041): `from_dock` for a docked mower (the map's dock, as the Device-Gateway plans it), else the mower's `position` in local metres.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |

### TransitOut

The transit a spot run would drive from the start to the plan's first point (blades off), planned by the same algorithm as the Device-Gateway's run.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `found` | boolean | yes | A route exists (the web app's route condition). |
| `from_dock` | boolean | yes |  |
| `length_m` | number | yes |  |
| `reason` | string or null | no | `no_route: ...` without a route. |
| `route` | array of array of number | yes | The route, local metres or `[lon, lat]` with `wgs84`; empty without one. |

### TurnStyle

How a spot run turns at the end of a lane (ADR 0043).

`in_place`: the mower rotates on the spot (fast, but an all-wheel-drive mower scuffs the turf). `arc`: a forward U-turn with a radius of at least half the lane spacing, or a bulb turn over the neighbouring lane when the spacing is narrower than the turning radius. `multi_point`: a three-point turn (forward arc, reverse arc with the blades off, forward arc); needs a drive link that can reverse (`MowerCapabilities.drive_reverse`).

Type: `"in_place"` \| `"arc"` \| `"multi_point"`
